description: Retrieve a list of NF instances currently registered in the NRF, optionally filtered by NF type and/or pagination parameters.

constraints.statement: The NF Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the "nf-instances" collection resource URI.
evidence: "The NF Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI \"nf-instances\" collection resource."
constraints.why_interesting: This is the required request method and target resource for the operation.

constraints.statement: Optional input filter criteria and pagination parameters may be included in query parameters.
evidence: "The optional input filter criteria (e.g. \"nf-type\") and pagination parameters for the retrieval request may be included in query parameters."
constraints.why_interesting: This defines how filtering and paging inputs are conveyed when used.

constraints.statement: On success, the NRF shall return 200 OK.
constraints.why_interesting: This is the required success status code.

constraints.statement: On success, the response body shall contain the URI of each registered NF in the NRF that satisfies the retrieval filter criteria.
evidence: "The response body shall contain the URI ... of each registered NF in the NRF that satisfy the retrieval filter criteria"
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required successful response content.

constraints.statement: On success, the response body shall contain an empty list if there are no NFs to return in the query result.
evidence: "or an empty list if there are no NFs to return in the query result"
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the observable empty-result behavior.

constraints.statement: On success, the response shall include the total count of items satisfying the filter criteria.
evidence: "The total count of items satisfying the filter criteria (e.g. \"nf-type\") should be returned in the response."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a response-content requirement for list retrieval.

constraints.statement: If the NF Service Consumer is not allowed to retrieve the registered NF instances, the NRF shall return 403 Forbidden.
evidence: "If the NF Service Consumer is not allowed to retrieve the registered NF instances, the NRF shall return \"403 Forbidden\" status code."
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the authorization failure behavior.

constraints.statement: If the NF Instance list retrieval fails due to errors in the input data in the URI query parameters, the NRF shall return 400 Bad Request.
evidence: "If the NF Instance list retrieval fails at the NRF due to errors in the input data in the URI query parameters, the NRF shall return \"400 Bad Request\" status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the client-error status for invalid query input.

constraints.statement: For a 400 Bad Request response, the NRF shall include the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
evidence: "with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error."
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the required error payload for invalid input.

constraints.statement: If the discovery request fails due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return 500 Internal Server Error.
evidence: "If the discovery request fails at the NRF due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return \"500 Internal Server Error\" status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the server-error status for internal failures.

constraints.statement: For a 500 Internal Server Error response, the NRF shall include the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
evidence: "with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error."
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the required error payload for internal failures.

constraints.statement: In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return a 3xx status code.
evidence: "In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return 3xx status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the allowed redirection status class.

constraints.statement: In the case of redirection, the NRF response shall contain a Location header.
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable header requirement for redirects.

constraints.statement: In the case of redirection, the Location header shall contain a URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
evidence: "with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance."
